rows.decisiveStep: The R1 freeze error substituted g−x=u(x−1) after deriving g=u(x−1); the correct expression is (u−1)x−u. Root divisibility and |g(1)|<|g(2)| force g=u(x−1), Q=(4/u)(x−2).
